switches.name: Link Previews
switches.description: Show previews with titles, descriptions, and images for links

switches.name: Blur Media From People You Don't Follow
switches.description: Images and link previews from accounts you don't follow stay hidden behind a blurred placeholder until you tap to reveal them

switches.name: Read Receipts
switches.description: Let others see when you've read their messages

surfaces.ariaSnapshot:
- main:
  - button
  - heading "Privacy & Security" [level=1]
  - heading "Privacy" [level=3]
  - text: Link Previews
  - paragraph: Show previews with titles, descriptions, and images for links
  - switch "Link Previews" [checked]
  - paragraph:
    - strong: "Privacy note:"
    - text: Some URLs (YouTube, Reddit, IPFS, etc.) are fetched directly from their services. Other URLs use third-party proxy servers to fetch metadata. These services may log the URLs you view.
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Third-party services used:"
    - link "allorigins.win":
      - /url: https://allorigins.win/
    - text: ","
    - link "corsproxy.io":
      - /url: https://corsproxy.io/
  - text: Blur Media From People You Don't Follow
  - paragraph: Images and link previews from accounts you don't follow stay hidden behind a blurred placeholder until you tap to reveal them
  - switch "Blur Media From People You Don't Follow" [checked]
  - heading "Direct Messages" [level=3]
  - text: Read Receipts
  - paragraph: Let others see when you've read their messages
  - switch "Read Receipts" [checked]
  - heading "NSFW Content" [level=3]
  - paragraph: How to handle posts their author flagged as NSFW
  - radiogroup:
    - radio "Warn first Cover NSFW posts until you choose to show them" [checked]
    - paragraph: Warn first
    - paragraph: Cover NSFW posts until you choose to show them
    - radio "Always show Show NSFW posts without a warning"
    - paragraph: Always show
    - paragraph: Show NSFW posts without a warning
    - radio "Hide Remove NSFW posts from your feeds"
    - paragraph: Hide
    - paragraph: Remove NSFW posts from your feeds
  - heading "Block Lists" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Follow trusted users' block lists to help filter your feed. When enabled, anyone they block will also be hidden from your feed.
  - paragraph: You're not following anyone yet
  - paragraph: Follow users to see them here
  - heading "Blocked Users" [level=3]
  - paragraph: You haven't blocked anyone
  - heading "Saved Shipping Addresses" [level=3]
  - paragraph: To save shipping addresses securely, you need to set up an encryption key. Your addresses will be encrypted so only you can access them.
  - paragraph: You can add an encryption key in the Privacy & Security section above.

switches.name: Potato Mode
switches.description: Disable blur effects and visual flair. Enable this if Yappr feels sluggish on your device.

surfaces.ariaSnapshot:
- main:

  - heading "Appearance" [level=1]
  - heading "Theme" [level=3]
